title: Ramayana becomes the first Indian film to top the UK and Ireland box office
headline: Ramayana Becomes First Indian Film to Top UK Box Office
caption:
Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend opened at No. 1 at the UK and Ireland box office over the weekend of 6–8 November. It is the first Indian film to top that chart. It took £1.7 million from 364 cinemas, and £2.2 million including previews.

Until now, second place was the best an Indian film had managed there. Jawan, for one, opened second behind The Nun II in September 2023.

At home, the Monday after Diwali was the film's biggest day so far. Tracker Sacnilk estimates ₹107.50 crore net in India on 9 November, from 23,911 shows, and ₹346.35 crore net over the first five days. Trackers' figures differ and can be revised.

Did you watch Ramayana in a cinema this Diwali, and in which language?

Sources: The Hollywood Reporter India, Screen, Variety, Sacnilk
